name: Hermes Agent
summary: An open-source, self-hosted personal agent from Nous Research. It writes and refines its own skills after complex tasks, keeps agent-curated memory with full-text session search, and reaches users through a single gateway for Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, email and more. It works with Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or any compatible endpoint.
facts: Agent-curated notes, FTS5 session search, Honcho user model
Local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, Daytona, Vercel Sandbox
goodFor: Always-on personal agent over chat apps
Agents that accumulate skills over time
watchOut: Self-written skills need review before you trust them
Broad surface area to secure (gateway, terminals)
